findings.where: article header and body at 375px, tile 375-00
findings.evidence: At 375px the right-hand anchor TOC ('Design Principal', 'Types', 'Common Butto...') keeps about 150px of the width, leaving the content column ~170px: 'Edit this page' and 'LLMs.md' wrap one or two characters per line, 'Design Principal' breaks over two lines at h2 size, and the button-type demo shrinks to an unreadable thumbnail.
findings.after: @media (max-width: 768px) { .ant-anchor-wrapper { display: none } } or move the TOC into a collapsible 'On this page' disclosure above the content.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: at 320 CSS px content must be readable without loss; text wrapped one character per line is effectively lost.

findings.evidence: focus.json: 18 header stops (logo, search, nav, four unnamed avatar links, version select, 中/En, RTL, theme buttons) then the full left-nav tree (Introduction ... Contrast and beyond) all precede the article; the 40-stop capture ends inside the left nav without reaching 'Button'. There is no skip link or main landmark target to jump to content.
findings.before: No bypass mechanism before ~60 repeated links
findings.after: Skip to content as the first focusable, with id="main-content" on the article.

findings.evidence: The guidance itself lives in the images (e.g. Don't: three blue primary buttons in one group; Do: primary + default + dropdown ordering). The caption text below covers only the verdict, and the images have no alt (sweep), so a screen-reader user gets 'Do / 1. Emphasize on the primary action' without the example it refers to.
findings.after: alt="Don't: a button group with three primary (blue) buttons side by side" — one sentence per diagram describing the arrangement shown.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: these images are instructional content, so alt="" would also fail.

strengths: Do/Don't verdicts are given in text ('Do', 'Don't') as well as by the blue/red rule, so colour is not the only cue (1.4.1 passes).
Live button demos are real <button> elements with visible labels; heading outline (h1 Button > h2 Types > h3/h4) matches the TOC.
